r0upyn.description_en:
IN-GAME ALSO SHOWN AS
A Very Challenging Task
A Most Trying Task
An tricky assignment has just arrived that I think you will be ideally suited for.
Expect to encounter [TARGET] aboard a heavily armed vessel near [LOCATION] and accompanied by some of the most highly-seasoned pilots that can be hired.
Deal with the escorts as you wish. As long as you kill [TARGET], I will be more than satisfied.
Respectfully,
Vaughn

一项棘手的任务刚到，我想你会非常适合。

预计 [TARGETNAME] 会在一艘重武装飞船上，他们会在 [LOCATION] 附近徘徊，并且雇佣了一些非常有经验的飞船驾驶员来护航。

护航船随便你怎么处置，只要 [TARGETNAME] 死了我就心满意足了。

恭敬地，
沃恩

-斯托斯

1v2v02.description_en:
Hi,
This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.
Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.
If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of [ITEM] that needs to go from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION].
No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold 2 SCU cargo containers, and a handheld tractor beam to move them around.
Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.
Sincerely,
Petra Ling
Managing Director of Cargo Operations
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
1v2v02.description_zh:
嗨，

我是佩特拉·玲，很荣幸能为你提供与玲家快递合作的新机会。我爸妈当初开这家公司，就是想在十字军这一带做又快又稳的快递服务，结果一炮而红，名气越大，生意也越做越大。

现在，在我的管理下，玲家快递即将迈出新的重要一步——开展货运业务。这项新服务的需求增长速度超出了我的预期，这对我们双方来说都是好消息。

如果你一直想从事货运行业，那么这个机会能帮你实现梦想。实践是最好的学习方式，我正好有一单 [ITEM] 需要从 [LOCATION] 运到 [DESTINATION]。

虽然不需要有相关经验，但有以下几点需要注意：所有提货和交付都必须通过货运电梯完成，或者使用自动装载。你需要有一艘能装得下最大 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，并且需要配备手持式牵引光束来搬运货物。

如果这次运输任务顺利完成，你将被提升为“值得信赖承包商”，之后会有更多的运输任务等着你。


此致，
佩特拉·玲
货运运营总经理
玲家快递


玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

1d030of.description_en:
Heyo,
Over at [LOCATION] we just got a refueling job for an entire small fleet of ships who all together need [FUELTYPE]. Talk about when it rains it pours!
The client will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Unfortunately, where they're held up isn't the nicest of sectors so I'd be alert for any tomfoolery while you're doing the run.
It'll be best to try get them all back on their way as soon as you can.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
1d030of.description_zh:
嘿，

在 [LOCATION] 那边，我们刚接到一项为整支小型舰队加油的任务，他们一共需要 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

不幸的是，他们所在的区域并非什么好地方，因此你在干活期间务必要警惕任何不法分子的捣乱。

最好是尽快让他们全部恢复航行。

一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

1rjovsk.description_en:
Who we are and what we do is not important. All you gotta know is that we need things to get done and we pay people to do it.
If everything goes well, we don’t ever have to meet. Doesn’t that sound good?
Got a good one to start you off, nice and simple. There’s a blackbox from a downed ship at [LOCATION] that we want.
All you have to do is take it to [DESTINATION] and you get paid. Easy right? Watch out for scavs, you never know what kind of weirdos are hanging around these abandoned ships.
-Bit Zeros
1rjovsk.description_zh:
我们是谁、干啥的不重要，你只要知道：我们找人办事，给钱，就完事儿。要是顺顺利利，咱压根不用见面，这不挺好吗？

先给你个简单的活儿热热身。有一架坠毁飞船的黑匣子，就在 [LOCATION]，我们想要。你只要把它送到 [DESTINATION]，钱立马到账，简单吧？小心垃圾佬，这种废船边上，啥怪人都能冒出来。

- 零比特

15jzjx6.description_en:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact [LOCATION] has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the <EM>[OBJECTS]</EM4> and generally causing me a massive headache.
With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a crew of your own to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any friendly ships that need help.
This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor 6 Council Scrip for a job well done.
Stows out.
15jzjx6.description_zh:
所以，我本以为咱们把事儿办得挺低调的，结果看来 [LOCATION] 跟猎头帮有关系这事儿还是走漏了风声。现在那帮狠角色在那边惹出大麻烦，盯着 [OBJECTS] 搞破坏，搞得我头都大了。

就凭这些不速之客手里的火力，你得带一帮自己的团队才能搞定。特别是还得护住那些需要帮忙的友方飞船。

这次行动必须万无一失，所以我给主承包商开出 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证的奖励，干漂亮了就归你。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

11cm9mm.description_en: A band of hired guns has been sent to mess with our interests over at [LOCATION]. Seems someone has been tipped off that if the [OBJECTS] there are destroyed that it will severely interrupt Headhunter operations in the area. That's a problem I want you to fix. Not gonna lie, theses mercs are no joke. It'd be foolish to go it alone. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor 7 Council Scrip for a job well done. Stows out.
11cm9mm.description_zh:
一群枪手被派来搅黄我们在 [LOCATION] 的生意。看来有人通风报信，说要是那里的 [OBJECTS] 被毁了，猎头帮在那片区域的行动就会大受阻碍。这正是个我得让你去解决的麻烦。

不跟你兜圈子了，这些佣兵可不是吃素的。单枪匹马去简直就是送死。所以你不仅要物资备齐，还得找几个信得过的朋友跟你并肩作战。

这次行动必须万无一失，所以只要干得漂亮，主承包商就能拿到 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证作为奖励。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

1mg53w9.description_en:
A couple of hours ago I was supposed to receive a shipment of gear from a pilot of mine. I don’t like late, so I need you to head to their location and recover my stuff. I’ve got trackers on the packages so they should be easy enough to find.
My gut says the pilot’s been ghosted. They knew how to handle a ship well, so the scavs that took them out must be decent. When you get my three packages back, take them to [DESTINATION] for me and I’ll wire you the creds.
-Twitch

几个小时前，我本应该收到一名飞行员运送的物资。我不喜欢迟到，所以你需要前往他们的那里把我的东西取回来。我已经给包裹安装了追踪器，应该很容易找到。

我的直觉告诉我飞行员可能遭遇了不测。他们很擅长驾驶飞船，所以袭击他们的那些不法分子应该也挺厉害的。等你把我的三个包裹取回来，把它们送到 [DESTINATION]，我会把报酬转给你。

-刺痛

nqy7kd.description_en:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Update:
It would be helpful to have the most recent energy anomaly data so that we can compare it to what you delivered last time. Any difference between the two data sets could prove useful.
Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and retrieve the Energy Anomaly data and deliver it to [DESTINATION].
Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.
Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.
Once you hand off this data, I'll send you a ASD Secure Drive that you can collect at your home location.

霍克罗事务所
案件文档 #JD10285
首席调查员：阿尔肯·马洛

案件更新：
如果能拿到最新的能量异常数据，对我们来说会很有帮助，这样我们可以把它和你上次提交的数据进行对比。两组数据之间的任何差异都可能非常有用。

合约调查员的行动：
探索工程翼楼，检索能量异常数据，并将其送到 [DESTINATION]。

补充说明：
小心站点现场可能出现的敌对势力。

前往玛瑙设施时，请使用可停放在大型机库的载具。

一旦你交出这些数据，我会给你发送一个ASD 安全驱动器，你可以在你的家园位置领取它们。

如果能拿到最新的能量异常数据，对我们来说会很有帮助，这样我们可以把它和你上次提交的数据进行对比。两组数据之间的任何差异都可能非常有用。

合约调查员的行动：
探索工程翼楼，检索能量异常数据，并将其送到 [DESTINATION]。

补充说明：
小心站点现场可能出现的敌对势力。

前往玛瑙设施时，请使用可停放在大型机库的载具。

一旦你交出这些数据，我会给你发送一个ASD 安全驱动器，你可以在你的家园位置领取它们。

1tb92jq.description_en:
Got a bunch of boxes sitting at [LOCATION] that have to be moved to [DESTINATION]. Seems easy enough, right? Well, guess it ain’t.
The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a handheld tractor beam and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done.
Stows out.
1tb92jq.description_zh:
在 [LOCATION] 有一堆箱子需要搬到 [DESTINATION]。听起来挺简单，对吧？可实际上并没那么容易。

本来负责搬运的那个傻逼试图一次性把所有箱子都扛过去，结果背扭了。所以，你知道的，或许可以带个牵引光束，像个正常人一样一次搬一个。不过，嘿，别让我告诉你怎么做你的工作。把事情办妥就行。带个手持式牵引光束也是个聪明选择。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

ri94nh.description_en:
Got ourselves in a real mess here. A Headhunters ship on an important mission got attacked near [LOCATION]. Can’t get too into the specifics but it’s absolutely vital that they survive. The People’s Alliance know this too because they’re throwing everything they can at ‘em.
Not gonna pull any punches. This is a serious-ass situation that many wouldn’t survive. If you do, I’ll sing your praises and make sure you’re paid well.
-Stows
ri94nh.description_zh:
我们这下可麻烦大了。一艘执行重要任务的猎头帮飞船在 [LOCATION] 附近遭到了攻击。虽然不能透露太多细节，但他们的生存绝对至关重要。人民联盟也必须知道这件事，因为他们正在倾尽全力对付我们。

我们不会手下留情。这是个非常严重的情况，很多人在这种情况下都活不下来。如果你能成功解决这个问题，我会好好表扬你，而且保证你会得到丰厚的报酬。

-斯托斯

161735s.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of refined materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.
[LOCATION] Many of these ores are extremely rare and difficult to find, detectable only when a rock has been cracked open.
Reminder, all the materials must be refined before delivery, and since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
舒宾星际目前正在寻求完成另一份精炼材料采购订单。我们非常感谢您在此事上的帮助。

[HINT_LOCATION] 这些矿石中的许多都极为稀有且难以寻找，只有在岩石被破开时才能探测到。

提醒一下，所有材料必须在交付前进行精炼，并且由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

cz38l4.description_en:
Hey there,
So the People’s Alliance hired us to move a load of cargo from Levski to [DESTINATION]. Honestly, I’m surprised that they export some of this stuff, but I guess they must sell something to be able to afford everything they import.
For the run itself, you’ll need a ship that can hold 24 SCU cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam to handle the containers. That should be it.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
cz38l4.description_zh:
所以人民联盟雇了我们从列夫斯基运一批货到 [DESTINATION]。说实话，我挺惊讶他们还出口这些东西的，不过我猜他们得卖点什么才能买得起那么多进口货。

这趟任务的话，你需要一艘能装 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸货物集装箱的飞船，还要配一把 手持式牵引光束来搬运集装箱。应该就这样了。

[CONTRACTOR]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员

lb2hnj.description_en:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******
RE: Moraine Data Retrieval
WORK BRIEF:
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.
We need someone to infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and make a copy of their server data. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there, so be careful.
While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.
PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery
AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco
lb2hnj.description_zh:
*********** 人民联盟 ***********
******/ “团结就是力量” /******

回复：冰碛帮数据检索

工作简报：
这事有点超出我们平时的业务范围，但鉴于冰碛帮最近袭击得越来越频繁，我们希望能摸清他们的活动据点，好让船员们绕开那些危险区域。

我们需要有人潜入一个疑似冰碛帮的设施，然后复制他们服务器的数据。听说那空间站平时很少有人，但你万一在那儿撞上冰碛帮的人，也务必小心。

虽然我们不提倡暴力，但这情报的潜在价值足以拯救双方许多人的性命。

报酬：
交付后按标准列出的费率结算。

授权人：
雷科·巴塔利亚

l8c1le.description_en:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.
If you head to [LOCATION], there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle 4 SCU cargo containers. To make your life easier, be sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run.
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
l8c1le.description_zh:
嗨，我们需要在星系中运输一些物资，想知道你是否能帮忙。我知道这超出了你通常的职责范围，但我现在选择不多。这也是一个很好的机会，展示你对繁荣公民更大使命的承诺。

如果你前往 [LOCATION]，应该能通过一个货运电梯找到一些可用的物资，我们需要你把它们送到 [DESTINATION] 的另一个货运电梯。

唯一需要注意事情就是，你的飞船必须能够处理 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 的货物集装箱。为了省点事，你最好随身带个手持式牵引光束。这应该是一次简单的运输。

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.
You and your most trusted support ships will head to [LOCATION] and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.
Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

你及你最信赖的支援飞船需要前往 [LOCATION]，清除所有埋伏于此的敌对目标。据知，他们惯以小股编队行动，因此务必确保全部敌人都已被歼灭后方可撤离。

mehkd8.description_en: Urgent ship support needed at [LOCATION]. A known destructive criminal organization has been testing the waters with one of our clients’ property for months, and has now raised hell by targeting the client’s [OBJECTS]. These assets are highly valuable, so need to keep those safe at all costs – though we know it’ll be no easy feat. I cannot stress enough how dangerous these guys are, so I wouldn’t hesitate to bring backup to deal with them. If you and the assets make it out intact, we’re offering a well-earned 7 MG Scrip to the main contractor. Best of luck, Eugene Walton Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement 'Security, Your Way' Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
mehkd8.description_zh:
[LOCATION] 急需飞船支援。一个臭名昭著的破坏性犯罪组织已盯上我们一位客户的财产长达数月，如今更是变本加厉，直接攻击该客户的 [OBJECTS]。这些资产非常有价值，必须不惜一切代价确保其安全，尽管我们也清楚这绝非易事。

我不得不强调，这些人极度危险，因此我会毫不犹豫地呼叫增援来对付他们。如果你能带着资产全身而退，我们将向成功完成此任务的主承包商提供一份实至名归的 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
调度员，福克斯韦尔安保

15e8afh.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Need an experienced pilot for this recovery contract. Unfortunately, the original delivery pilot was targeting by a group of outlaws. Thankfully, the client’s packages are still sitting in their damaged ship located at [LOCATION].
You’ll potentially need to bring some backup with you to ensure the successful collection and delivery of the packages.
PACKAGES TO RECOVER
· 4x [ITEM1]
DROP OFF LOCATION
· Deliver to [DESTINATION]
Considering the danger of this contract, we’re willing to offer a slight pay increase as hazard pay.
TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.
15e8afh.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

需要一位有经验的飞行员来执行这次打捞任务。不幸的是，原定的送货飞行员遭到了一伙不法分子的袭击。所幸，客户的包裹仍留在那艘受损的飞船上，位置在[LOCATION]。

你可能需要带些帮手一起去，以确保顺利取回并交付这些包裹。

要找回的包裹
     · 4x [ITEM1]

卸货地点
     · 送至 [DESTINATION]

鉴于这项任务的危险性，我们愿意提供额外的危险津贴以提高报酬。

以你的工作为荣 - 即使你是外包承包商，你也代表红风货运。切勿故意做出任何损害公司声誉的行为。

jgv9cy.description_en:
Our crew at [LOCATION] needs help. Enemy ships are swarming the area and attacking anything and everything they can find. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site has some absolutely crucial gear and personnel that we can’t have destroyed or compromised.
Considering the size and scale of the attack, you’re gonna need a fully supplied ship and some reliable wingmen. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and I’ll send you specifics on where you’re needed most.
To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn a bonus 9 Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.
- Stow
jgv9cy.description_zh:
我们在 [DEFENDLOCATIONWRAPPERLOCATION] 的船员需要支援。敌方飞船正在这片区域疯狂出没，见什么打什么。这已经够糟了，但这个地点还有一些极其关键的设备和人员，绝对不能被摧毁或者落入敌人手里。

考虑到这次袭击的规模，你得有一艘全副武装的飞船，再带上几个靠谱的僚机伙伴。召集你的队伍，飞到现场，我会告诉你最需要支援的具体位置。

为了表明我们对完成任务的重视程度，只要确保一切顺利，没有任何闪失，主承包人将会获得一笔额外奖金：[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION]. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to 4 SCU in size.
Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

“您的货物，有我保障”

几乎没有比这更轻松的赚取信用点的方法了。只要小心点，因为这条路线可不是最安全的区域。还有别忘了随身携带一个手持式牵引光束。

1ejq6yj.description_en:
Greetings,
Unfortunately, I've just received word that one of RSI's Discovery Month host locations has been attacked by a group of outlaws. Fortunately, the criminals in question left a rather messy trail of evidence behind allowing us to easily track down their location.
We need a contractor to head to [LOCATION] and deal with the criminals on site before they can strike again.
Arm yourself appropriately and be wary.
Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer
Northrock Service Group
1ejq6yj.description_zh:
向您问候，

很遗憾，我刚收到消息，RSI 探索月的一个承办地点遭到了一群不法分子的袭击。好在这帮家伙留下了一堆乱七八糟的证据，让我们能轻松追踪到他们的位置。

我们需要一名承包商前往 [LOCATION]，趁他们还没再次动手，就地解决这帮不法分子。

装备好自己，多加小心。

祝你好运，
艾德里安·杜-布伊松
后勤官员
北境之岩服务团队

1x4ivb1.description_en:
Hiya,
We've been given a really important task by RSI to deliver some crucial goods for their Discovery Month event and I need our best contractors on this one.
We have a ton of supplies moved from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION].
If you think you're up to the task, go ahead and accept this contract, get a ship that can carry 16 SCU, and grab your handheld tractor beam. All pick ups and drop offs are done by freight elevators.
Good luck and safe travels!
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
1x4ivb1.description_zh:
嗨呀，

RSI 给了我们一个相当重要的任务，要为他们的探索月活动运送一些关键货物，而我需要我最得力的承包商上阵。

我们有一大批物资要从 [LOCATION] 运到 [DESTINATION]。

如果你觉得自己能胜任，就接下这份合约，弄一艘能装得下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸集装箱的飞船，再带上你的 手持牵引光束。所有取货和卸货都通过货运电梯完成。

祝你好运，一路平安！

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

1n7fdhd.description_en:
Hi,
Not often we get to work with RSI, so pretty honored they offered this job to us.
Got some party supplies that need delivering from [LOCATION] to their new pop-up event at [DESTINATION].
Your ship will need to be able to carry 4 SCU cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam would be highly recommended to move the boxes.
Thanks,
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling
Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.
1n7fdhd.description_zh:
嗨，

我们很少有机会跟 RSI 合作，所以他们把这个活儿交给我们，我们挺荣幸的。

有一批派对用品要从 [LOCATION] 送到他们在 [DESTINATION] 新开的快闪活动现场。

你的飞船得能装下 [MISSIONMAXSCUSIZE] 尺寸的集装箱，另外强烈建议带上一个 手持牵引光束 来搬箱子。

感谢，
康妮·玲
运输协调员
玲家快递

玲家快递深知宇宙危险莫测，因此制定了多项协议，以保护你和客户货物的安全。为确保你不会因不可控因素受罚，总报酬将按成功交付的货物比例计算。每趟运输都会设置交付倒计时，倒计时结束时仍未交付的货物将被标记为被盗，并按盗窃处理。所有取货和送货必须通过自动装载或货运电梯完成。

irw31z.description_en:
Greetings,
Northrock has been hard at work to identify some of the key players in the recent attacks on RSI's Discovery Month event. As a result, we have located a high ranking member of a local outlaw gang named [TARGET].
We've triangulated their last known location was [LOCATION], where we believe they are preparing their next attack. Intel suggest they're a cautious individual that may require drawing out by eliminating their comrades first. Bringing a team of skilled operators is heavily advised.
Best of luck,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer
Northrock Service Group
irw31z.description_zh:
向您问候，

北境之岩一直在全力追查近期针对 RSI 探索月活动的一系列袭击中的几个关键人物。经过努力，我们已经定位到当地一个不法帮派的一名高层成员，名叫 [TARGETNAME]。

通过三角定位，其最后已知位置是 [LOCATION]，我们相信他们正在那里筹备下一次袭击。情报显示，此人行事谨慎，可能得先干掉他的同伙，才能把他引出来。强烈建议带上一支技术娴熟的行动小队。

祝你好运，
艾德里安·杜-布伊松
后勤官员
北境之岩服务团队

6vfuaf.description_en:
Hey again,
Found a beacon from one of those new [SHIP] ships out in [LOCATION] that needs refueling. Just got off comms with them and they said they ran into some trouble with some local outlaws and had to make a sharp exit so weren't able to fill up on <EM4>[FUELTYPE]<EM4> before heading out.
The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
Hoping we can get out to those nice folks before anything bad happens to them, been hearing a lot of nasty rumors about those parts recently. Watch your back and make sure you get home safely.
Happy trails,
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
""We’ve got your back""
6vfuaf.description_zh:
嘿，又是我，

在 [LOCATION] 收到一个信标，来自一艘新款 [SHIP] 飞船，需要加油。刚跟他们通了话，他们说碰上了当地的不法分子，只好紧急撤离，出发前没来得及加满 [FUELTYPE]。

客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

希望能赶在坏事发生前，去到那些好心人身边，最近那一带的传言可不太妙。多留个心眼，务必平安回家。
一路顺风，

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

1q2b82w.description_en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer
> About the job <
To help satisfy a recent order,we are seeking contractors to help source Recycled Material Composite (RMC), unrefined Construction Materials (Rubble, Pieces, or Salvage), and components by stripping and fracturing abandoned ships; removing the requested parts by hand with a tractor beam. We recommend searching for wreckage at Lagrange points or you could purchase a salvage claim from us in your Contract Manager.
Once acquired, deliver the materials to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.

zd15xy.description_en:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the [OBJECTS] at [LOCATION]. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.
Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any friendly ships need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.
If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding 3 Council Scrip for the main contractor.
- Stows
zd15xy.description_zh:
有个新冒出来的帮派正让猎头帮头疼得要命，他们居然把 [OBJECTS] 给盯上了，地点就在 [LOCATION]。这事儿可不太妙，毕竟我们很在意那边人的安危，更别提要是让他们搞出大动静，搞不好会把接下来的行动全搅黄了。

你一到那儿就赶紧去阻止他们，别让他们造成永久性破坏。要是发现有友方飞船需要帮忙，你也得搭把手。别指望这帮家伙好对付，但只要你保持冷静，应该还是能摆平他们的。

要是你还缺点动力，那么我特意给主承包商额外加了 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证。

- 斯托斯

POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TECH PREVIEW TESTING:
Complete this mission to get blueprints for Volt weapons. For this test, these blueprints have some slots that accepting different materials for varying stat adjustments.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract."

1ro3wij.description_en:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off?
If so, start by seeing what’s around the location marker on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing two friends to join the patrol.
You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of 18 Council Scrip.
Stows out.
1ro3wij.description_zh:
有些人不爽咱们在这儿混，专门派小队搞咱们的船。敢不敢去几个据点让他们明白——猎头帮可不是吓大的？

从 HUD 上的位置标记开始侦查，完事带你去点其他几个火药桶。出发前最好把家伙事儿备齐。我建议你多带点弹药，再拉上两个朋友一起参与巡逻。

给猎头帮办成这事儿的话，我保证让主承包商多拿 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 当外快。

- 斯托斯

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = 1000
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
Looking for a competent contractor who can salvage a messy situation. A client's trusted pilot apparently wasn't so trustworthy and made off with a shipment. But thankfully our trackers are reporting the shipment's static for the moment, waiting to be picked up. If we play our cards right, there's still time to resolve this.
The abandoned ship is located at [LOCATION] and will need a heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the goods. A ship that can handle [MAX_SCU] cargo containers is a necessity, and expect contact from whatever outlaws this double-crossing pilot was hoping to sell to.
Once recovered, deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION].
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

os91t0.description_en:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.
If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.
[TARGET] was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.
You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.
They’ve been spotted around [LOCATION], so get there and take care of it.
Stows out.
os91t0.description_zh:
你知道我们是谁，你知道我们在做什么。星系有点拥挤，所以我们在寻找一些优秀的士兵来帮助我们在这里立足。

如果你愿意，也不介意弄脏手，我们有办法证明你具备我们所需要的素质。

[TARGETNAME] 是我们曾经的成员，他背叛了我们，把我们出卖给了异种威胁，导致我们的一些兄弟姐妹被杀。现在他们以为可以毫无后果地过日子。

你把他们解决掉，你就能得到晋升，公平的交易。

他们最近在 [LOCATION] 附近被发现，所以赶紧过去处理掉他们。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

Need someone to knock out a security patrol. You’ll need to go to the location marker on your HUD and then scan several designated waypoints ensuring that they’re safe and secure.
Satellites in that region have been acting up recently. Not exactly sure what’s going on out there, but best be prepared in case there’s any trouble.
Complete this contract and the main contractor will get a bonus payment of 4 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

完成这份合约，主承包商将获得 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

13auq4p.description_en:
An outlaw who’s been on the run finally returned to the system. Seems like they hoped that disappearing for a bit would make us forget about them. They’re not even trying to hide their identity or vary their routine which means we know exactly where they’re going to be.
Latest intel indicates that they’re flying a [TARGET] and will be passing by [LOCATION] soon. I’ve already scoped out an emission cloud that’s a perfect place for you to find cover, power down your ship, and wait. Only real variable is if they’ll be alone or not. We’ve heard they sometimes roll with friends that all fly single-seaters. Landing that first surprise strike will be important as this crew is battle-tested, but we’ll have reinforcements at the ready to provide support if you need them.
Get this done and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of 3 MG Scrip.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'
Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.
13auq4p.description_zh:
有个逃亡的不法分子终于回到这个星系了。他们可能以为消失一阵子就能让我们忘记追捕他们。这家伙连伪装身份身份和改变行动路线都懒得做，所以我们完全掌握了行踪。

最新情报显示他们驾驶着 [AMBUSHTARGET]，很快就会经过 [LOCATION]。我已经物色好一处辐射云，最适合你关掉引擎躲藏起来静候目标。唯一不确定的是他们是否单独行动。听说这帮人有时会带着开单座机的同伙。第一波突袭至关重要，毕竟对方是群老油条。不过只要你需要，我们随时能派增援。

搞定这活儿，我们就会给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证作为额外奖励。

祝你好运，

尤金·沃尔顿
